prompt: On Settings › Profile (app/components/settings/ProfileForm.vue), the Bio field allows 160 characters but does not say so. Add a counter under it that reads like "17/160" and updates as the user types; past 160 it turns to the error colour and reads like "170/160", and the form's existing message about the limit shows as it does today on submit.

constraints.text: Built on the app's form components (FormDescription, FormMessage) and its text styles, as the other fields are.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
Short, at the limit, over the limit, in the dark theme and in a narrow window.
The counter is tied to the field and announced politely, not on every key; over the limit is not shown by colour alone.
Only the profile form changes; the other settings pages are unchanged, and no test is removed.

states.name: over-dark
states.description: The same, in the dark theme.

states.name: narrow
states.description: The form in a phone-sized window.

acceptance.name: the counter follows what is typed
